demo_kno0001.question: How many days of annual leave do I get?
demo_kno0001.answer: You get 21 working days of annual leave for each full year, building up month by month. After your first year you can carry over up to 10 unused days into the next year.
demo_kno0001.keywords: annual leave vacation holiday days entitlement carry over

demo_kno0002.question: How do I request leave?
demo_kno0002.answer: Open Attendance & Leave, choose Request Leave, pick the type and dates, then submit. Your line manager (or their delegate) approves it and you are notified. Please give at least 3 working days’ notice for annual leave.
demo_kno0002.keywords: apply request book leave time off approval notice

demo_kno0003.question: Do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
demo_kno0003.answer: Yes, for any sick absence longer than 2 days. Attach the certificate when you submit the request. Sick leave is paid in full up to 30 days a year.
demo_kno0003.keywords: sick leave medical certificate doctor illness

demo_kno0004.question: What is the maternity and paternity leave entitlement?
demo_kno0004.answer: Maternity leave is 98 calendar days (14 weeks) on full pay, with 14 days’ notice and a medical certificate. Paternity leave is 3 working days on full pay, taken within 30 days of the birth.
demo_kno0004.keywords: maternity paternity baby birth newborn parental

demo_kno0005.question: Is there bereavement leave?
demo_kno0005.answer: Yes. You get 3 working days of paid bereavement leave on the death of a close family member. Tell your manager as soon as you can and record it as Bereavement leave.

demo_kno0006.question: Can I take unpaid leave?
demo_kno0006.answer: Unpaid leave can be agreed for personal reasons with your manager’s and HR’s approval, with at least 3 working days’ notice. It is not paid and does not build up annual leave.

demo_kno0007.question: What are the standard working hours?
demo_kno0007.answer: The working week is Sunday to Thursday, 08:00 to 16:00, with a 10-minute grace period at the start of the day. Friday and Saturday are the weekend.
demo_kno0007.keywords: working hours shift schedule time weekend start finish

demo_kno0008.question: I forgot to clock in. How do I fix it?
demo_kno0008.answer: Submit an attendance correction from the Attendance page with the date and the reason. Your manager approves it and the record is updated. Please do this within 3 working days.
demo_kno0008.keywords: forgot clock in out missing attendance correction fix punch

demo_kno0009.question: How is overtime paid?
demo_kno0009.answer: Approved overtime is paid at 150% of your hourly rate on ordinary days and 200% on rest days and public holidays. Overtime must be approved by your line manager in advance.
demo_kno0009.keywords: overtime extra hours paid rate rest day holiday

demo_kno0010.question: When is salary paid?
demo_kno0010.answer: Salary is paid on the 25th of each month into your registered bank account. If the 25th is a weekend or public holiday, it is paid on the working day before.
demo_kno0010.keywords: salary pay day payment date payslip when paid

demo_kno0011.question: How do I get a salary certificate?
demo_kno0011.answer: Raise an HR ticket in the Payroll category and say who it should be addressed to. Salary certificates are normally ready within 2 working days.
demo_kno0011.keywords: salary certificate letter bank loan proof income

demo_kno0012.question: Who do I contact about a payslip error?
demo_kno0012.answer: Raise an HR ticket in the Payroll category within 5 days of receiving the payslip, and say which line looks wrong. Payroll will reply and correct it in the next run if needed.
demo_kno0012.keywords: payslip error mistake wrong deduction allowance missing

demo_kno0013.question: How are salary increases decided?
demo_kno0013.answer: Increases follow the annual merit review in January. They depend on your performance rating and where your salary sits in your pay band. Your manager will share the outcome with you.
demo_kno0013.keywords: salary increase raise merit review promotion pay band

demo_kno0014.question: What medical cover do I have?
demo_kno0014.answer: The group medical plan covers you, your spouse and up to 3 children for inpatient and outpatient care. Inpatient treatment needs pre-approval from the insurer. Enrol or review your plan in Benefits.
demo_kno0014.keywords: medical insurance health cover hospital doctor family benefits

demo_kno0015.question: When can I change my benefits?
demo_kno0015.answer: You can change your benefits during open enrolment each year, or within 30 days of a life event such as marriage or the birth of a child.
demo_kno0015.keywords: benefits change enrolment open enrollment life event marriage

demo_kno0016.question: How do I book business travel?
demo_kno0016.answer: Submit a travel request in Travel at least 7 days before departure. Your manager approves it and the travel desk books flights and hotels. Per diem rates depend on your grade.
demo_kno0016.keywords: travel trip flight hotel business booking per diem

demo_kno0017.question: How do I claim travel expenses?
demo_kno0017.answer: Submit your expense claim within 14 days of returning, with receipts attached. Approved claims are paid with the next payroll run.
demo_kno0017.keywords: expense claim reimbursement receipts travel refund

demo_kno0018.question: How does the performance cycle work?
demo_kno0018.answer: Objectives are set at the start of the year, with a mid-year check-in and an annual appraisal. Ratings are calibrated by HR across departments before they are published to you.
demo_kno0018.keywords: performance review appraisal objectives goals cycle rating calibration

demo_kno0019.question: What do the performance ratings mean?
demo_kno0019.answer: Ratings run from 1 to 5. A 3 means you fully meet expectations, 4 means you exceed them and 5 is outstanding. Ratings 1 and 2 trigger a support plan with your manager.
demo_kno0019.keywords: rating scale score meaning exceeds meets expectations

demo_kno0020.question: What happens in my first week?
demo_kno0020.answer: You will have a welcome session with HR, receive your laptop and system access, meet your buddy and agree your first objectives. Your onboarding checklist in SNAP shows each step.
demo_kno0020.keywords: first week onboarding new joiner induction welcome buddy

demo_kno0021.question: How long is the probation period?
demo_kno0021.answer: Probation is 3 months. Your manager reviews your progress at around 60 days, and HR sends your confirmation letter when the period ends successfully.
demo_kno0021.keywords: probation period confirmation new employee months

demo_kno0022.question: How do I enrol on a training course?
demo_kno0022.answer: Open Training, browse the catalogue and request a place. Your manager approves it, and the cost is taken from your learning budget.
demo_kno0022.keywords: training course enrol learning development budget workshop

demo_kno0023.question: Are any courses mandatory?
demo_kno0023.answer: Yes. Everyone completes the Code of Conduct, Information Security Awareness and Preventing Harassment & Discrimination courses within 30 days of joining, and refreshes them every year.
demo_kno0023.keywords: mandatory compulsory course compliance code of conduct security awareness

demo_kno0024.question: How do I raise a concern confidentially?
demo_kno0024.answer: Go to Employee Relations and choose Raise a Concern. You can send it anonymously. Only the Employee Relations team in HR can see it, and they decide the next steps.
demo_kno0024.keywords: concern complaint harassment report speak up confidential anonymous grievance whistleblow

demo_kno0025.question: What is the warning process?
demo_kno0025.answer: Warnings follow a ladder: verbal warning, first written warning, second written warning, final written warning, then suspension or termination. Each warning stays active for a set number of months, then lapses. You can appeal in writing within 5 working days.
demo_kno0025.keywords: warning disciplinary discipline process appeal ladder verbal written

demo_kno0026.question: I am locked out of my account. What do I do?
demo_kno0026.answer: Accounts lock after repeated wrong passwords. Raise an HR ticket in IT & Access and HR will unlock it and send you a new activation code.
demo_kno0026.keywords: locked out account password sign in login access reset

demo_kno0027.question: How do I reset my password?
demo_kno0027.answer: Ask HR for an activation code through an IT & Access ticket. On the sign-in screen choose to activate your account, enter your Employee ID and the code, and set a new password.
demo_kno0027.keywords: password reset forgot activation code sign in

demo_kno0028.question: Is there an employee assistance programme?
demo_kno0028.answer: Yes. A confidential counselling line is available 24 hours a day, free of charge, for you and your immediate family. Details are on the Wellbeing page of the intranet.
demo_kno0028.keywords: wellbeing counselling mental health stress support assistance programme

demo_kno0029.question: Can I work from home?
demo_kno0029.answer: Eligible roles can work from home up to 2 days a week with their manager’s approval. Customer-facing and field roles are not eligible. See the Remote Working Policy for details.
demo_kno0029.keywords: work from home remote hybrid wfh telework

demo_kno0030.question: How does the employee referral bonus work?
demo_kno0030.answer: If you refer a candidate who is hired, you receive a referral bonus once they complete their probation. Send the CV to HR before the candidate applies so the referral is logged.
demo_kno0030.keywords: referral bonus refer friend candidate recruitment hire

demo_kno0031.question: How do I apply for an internal vacancy?
demo_kno0031.answer: You can apply for internal vacancies after 12 months in your current role. Tell your manager, then submit your application to HR using the vacancy reference.
demo_kno0031.keywords: internal vacancy transfer job apply move promotion

demo_bc01.title: Offices closed tomorrow for non-essential staff
demo_bc01.body: Because of the severe weather warning, all offices will be closed tomorrow for non-essential staff. Field and network operations teams should follow their on-call plans. Please confirm that you have read this message, and check on colleagues who may be travelling.

ar.title: إغلاق المكاتب غدًا للموظفين غير الأساسيين
ar.body: بسبب التحذير من الطقس القاسي، ستُغلق جميع المكاتب غدًا أمام الموظفين غير الأساسيين. على فرق الميدان وعمليات الشبكة اتباع خطط المناوبة. يرجى تأكيد قراءتكم لهذه الرسالة، والاطمئنان على الزملاء الذين قد يكونون في سفر.

fr.title: Bureaux fermés demain pour le personnel non essentiel
fr.body: En raison de l’alerte météo, tous les bureaux seront fermés demain pour le personnel non essentiel. Les équipes terrain et exploitation réseau suivent leurs plans d’astreinte. Merci de confirmer que vous avez lu ce message et de prendre des nouvelles des collègues en déplacement.

demo_bc02.title: Updated Code of Conduct: please acknowledge
demo_bc02.body: The Code of Conduct has been updated with clearer guidance on gifts, conflicts of interest and speaking up. Read the new version in the HR Assistant under Policy Documents and acknowledge it here by the end of the month.

ar.title: تحديث مدونة السلوك: يرجى الإقرار بها
ar.body: تم تحديث مدونة السلوك بإرشادات أوضح بشأن الهدايا وتضارب المصالح والإبلاغ عن المخالفات. اطلعوا على النسخة الجديدة في مساعد الموارد البشرية ضمن وثائق السياسات، وأقرّوا بها هنا قبل نهاية الشهر.

fr.title: Code de conduite mis à jour : merci de l’accuser
fr.body: Le Code de conduite a été mis à jour avec des consignes plus claires sur les cadeaux, les conflits d’intérêts et le signalement. Consultez la nouvelle version dans l’Assistant RH, rubrique Documents de politique, et accusez-en réception ici avant la fin du mois.

demo_bc03.title: Public holiday schedule for the coming weeks
demo_bc03.body: The offices will be closed on the upcoming public holidays. Network and customer care teams will work the published holiday rota, and holiday work is paid at double rate.

ar.title: جدول العطل الرسمية للأسابيع المقبلة
ar.body: ستُغلق المكاتب في العطل الرسمية القادمة. ستعمل فرق الشبكة وخدمة العملاء وفق جدول المناوبات المنشور، ويُحتسب العمل في العطل بضعف الأجر.

fr.title: Calendrier des jours fériés des prochaines semaines
fr.body: Les bureaux seront fermés lors des prochains jours fériés. Les équipes réseau et service client suivent le planning de garde publié, et le travail les jours fériés est payé double.

demo_bc04.title: Mid-year scorecard review: actions for managers
demo_bc04.body: Managers, please review your team’s scorecards, add comments and submit your recommendations before the review window closes. Talent Management will hold two drop-in sessions this week.

ar.title: مراجعة بطاقات الأداء لمنتصف العام: إجراءات للمدراء
ar.body: أيها المدراء، يرجى مراجعة بطاقات أداء فرقكم وإضافة التعليقات وتقديم توصياتكم قبل إغلاق نافذة المراجعة. ستعقد إدارة المواهب جلستين مفتوحتين هذا الأسبوع.

fr.title: Revue des scorecards de mi-année : actions pour les managers
fr.body: Managers, merci de revoir les scorecards de vos équipes, d’ajouter vos commentaires et de soumettre vos recommandations avant la fin de la période de revue. Le service Gestion des talents tient deux permanences ouvertes cette semaine.

demo_bc05.title: Planned system maintenance this weekend
demo_bc05.body: Core internal systems will be unavailable for about three hours during the planned maintenance window. Please save your work. No action is needed from staff outside the Technology division.

ar.title: صيانة مجدولة للأنظمة في نهاية هذا الأسبوع
ar.body: ستتوقف الأنظمة الداخلية الأساسية عن العمل لمدة ثلاث ساعات تقريبًا خلال نافذة الصيانة المجدولة. يرجى حفظ أعمالكم. لا يلزم أي إجراء من الموظفين خارج قطاع التقنية.

fr.title: Maintenance programmée des systèmes ce week-end
fr.body: Les systèmes internes essentiels seront indisponibles environ trois heures pendant la fenêtre de maintenance. Merci d’enregistrer votre travail. Aucune action n’est requise pour le personnel hors de la division Technologie.

demo_bc06.title: New shift roster rules for Customer Care
demo_bc06.body: From the next roster, shift swaps must be requested at least 48 hours ahead and approved by the team lead. The updated roster rules are attached to the HR Assistant under Policy Documents. Please acknowledge that you have read them.

ar.title: قواعد جديدة لجدول المناوبات في Customer Care
ar.body: اعتبارًا من الجدول القادم، يجب طلب تبديل المناوبات قبل 48 ساعة على الأقل وأن يوافق عليه قائد الفريق. قواعد الجدول المحدثة مرفقة في مساعد الموارد البشرية ضمن وثائق السياسات. يرجى الإقرار بأنكم قرأتموها.

fr.title: Nouvelles règles du planning pour Customer Care
fr.body: À partir du prochain planning, les échanges de postes doivent être demandés au moins 48 heures à l’avance et approuvés par le chef d’équipe. Les règles mises à jour sont jointes dans l’Assistant RH, rubrique Documents de politique. Merci d’accuser réception.

demo_bc07.title: Open enrolment for medical cover has closed
demo_bc07.body: Open enrolment for the group medical plan is now closed. If you have had a life event such as marriage or the birth of a child, you have 30 days to update your cover. Contact HR Operations.

ar.title: أُغلق التسجيل المفتوح للتأمين الطبي
ar.body: أُغلق التسجيل المفتوح للتأمين الطبي الجماعي. إذا طرأ حدث في حياتكم مثل الزواج أو ولادة طفل، فلديكم 30 يومًا لتحديث تغطيتكم. تواصلوا مع عمليات الموارد البشرية.

fr.title: La période d’inscription à la couverture médicale est close
fr.body: La période d’inscription au régime médical collectif est désormais close. En cas d’événement de vie, comme un mariage ou une naissance, vous avez 30 jours pour mettre à jour votre couverture. Contactez les Opérations RH.

demo_bc08.title: Network incident resolved
demo_bc08.body: The network incident earlier this month is now fully resolved. Thank you to everyone on call. A post-incident review will be shared with the operations teams.

ar.title: تم حل حادث الشبكة
ar.body: تم حل حادث الشبكة الذي وقع في وقت سابق من هذا الشهر بالكامل. شكرًا لكل من كان على المناوبة. ستتم مشاركة مراجعة ما بعد الحادث مع فرق العمليات.

fr.title: Incident réseau résolu
fr.body: L’incident réseau survenu plus tôt ce mois-ci est maintenant entièrement résolu. Merci à tous ceux qui étaient d’astreinte. Un retour d’expérience sera partagé avec les équipes d’exploitation.

demo_bc09.title: Quarter-end close calendar
demo_bc09.body: The quarter-end close calendar is available. Please submit all expense claims and purchase approvals by the cut-off dates in the calendar. Late items will move to the next period.

ar.title: تقويم الإقفال المالي لنهاية الربع
ar.body: تقويم الإقفال المالي لنهاية الربع متاح الآن. يرجى تقديم جميع مطالبات المصروفات وموافقات الشراء قبل المواعيد النهائية الواردة فيه. ستُرحَّل الطلبات المتأخرة إلى الفترة التالية.

fr.title: Calendrier de clôture de fin de trimestre
fr.body: Le calendrier de clôture de fin de trimestre est disponible. Merci de soumettre toutes les notes de frais et validations d’achat avant les dates limites indiquées. Les éléments tardifs seront reportés à la période suivante.

demo_bc10.title: Wellbeing week is coming
demo_bc10.body: Wellbeing week starts soon, with counselling drop-ins, a walking challenge and a short session on managing workload. Registration opens on the first day.

ar.title: أسبوع العافية قادم
ar.body: يبدأ أسبوع العافية قريبًا، مع جلسات استشارية مفتوحة وتحدي المشي وجلسة قصيرة حول إدارة ضغط العمل. يفتح التسجيل في اليوم الأول.

fr.title: La semaine du bien-être arrive
fr.body: La semaine du bien-être débute bientôt, avec des permanences d’écoute, un défi de marche et une courte session sur la gestion de la charge de travail. Les inscriptions ouvrent le premier jour.

demo_bc11.title: Tower safety briefing: mandatory for all field teams
demo_bc11.body: All field and network operations staff must attend the updated tower safety briefing. Please read the briefing note and acknowledge it. No one will be scheduled for tower work without an acknowledgement on file.

ar.title: إحاطة السلامة في الأبراج: إلزامية لجميع فرق الميدان
ar.body: يجب على جميع موظفي الميدان وعمليات الشبكة حضور إحاطة السلامة المحدثة في الأبراج. يرجى قراءة مذكرة الإحاطة والإقرار بها. لن يُجدوَل أي شخص للعمل على الأبراج دون إقرار مسجل.

fr.title: Briefing sécurité des pylônes : obligatoire pour toutes les équipes terrain
fr.body: Tout le personnel terrain et exploitation réseau doit suivre le briefing sécurité mis à jour sur les pylônes. Merci de lire la note et d’en accuser réception. Personne ne sera planifié pour un travail en hauteur sans accusé de réception enregistré.

demo_bc12.title: Welcome to our newest colleagues
demo_bc12.body: Please join us in welcoming Noor Al-Naimi (Field Service Technician), Karrar Al-Khafaji (Field Service Technician), Rami Al-Hashimi (Security Analyst), Ruaa Al-Janabi (Sales Executive). Say hello and help them settle in.

ar.title: أهلًا بزملائنا الجدد
ar.body: يسعدنا أن نرحب بزملائنا الجدد: Noor Al-Naimi (Field Service Technician)، Karrar Al-Khafaji (Field Service Technician)، Rami Al-Hashimi (Security Analyst)، Ruaa Al-Janabi (Sales Executive). رحّبوا بهم وساعدوهم على الاندماج.

fr.title: Bienvenue à nos nouveaux collègues
fr.body: Joignez-vous à nous pour souhaiter la bienvenue à Noor Al-Naimi (Field Service Technician), Karrar Al-Khafaji (Field Service Technician), Rami Al-Hashimi (Security Analyst), Ruaa Al-Janabi (Sales Executive). Dites-leur bonjour et aidez-les à s’installer.

demo_sv01.title: Annual Engagement Survey
demo_sv01.description: A full engagement check across manager, growth, recognition, wellbeing, company and team.

questions.text: My manager treats me with respect.
My manager gives me useful feedback.
I know what is expected of me at work.
I see a clear path to grow my career here.
I have opportunities to learn and develop new skills.
I receive recognition when I do good work.
I feel my contribution is valued.
I can keep a healthy balance between work and life.
I feel safe to speak up and share ideas.
I understand where the company is heading.
I am proud to work for this company.
Senior leaders communicate openly and honestly.
My team works well together.
I have the tools and resources to do my job well.
On a scale of 0–10, how likely are you to recommend us as a place to work?
What is the one thing we could do to make this a better place to work?

demo_sv02.title: Employee NPS (eNPS)
demo_sv02.description: One question and one comment — the quickest way to track loyalty over time.

questions.text: On a scale of 0–10, how likely are you to recommend this company as a place to work?
What is the main reason for your score?

demo_sv03.title: Inclusion & Belonging Pulse
demo_sv03.description: Eight questions on belonging, fair treatment and voice — feeds the IDE scorecard. Results show only when enough people answer.

questions.text: I feel I belong at this company.
People here are treated fairly, whatever their background.
I can be myself at work.
My ideas are listened to and taken seriously.
I feel safe raising a concern about unfair treatment.
My manager creates an inclusive team environment.
Opportunities to grow here are open to everyone.
I can get the flexibility or adjustments I need to do my job well.
What one change would make this a more inclusive place to work?

demo_sv04.title: Quick Pulse 2026 Q4
demo_sv04.description: Five questions, two minutes — a regular read on how people feel.

questions.text: I feel motivated to do my best work right now.
I have the support I need from my manager.
My workload is manageable.
I would recommend working here to a friend.
Is there anything we should start, stop or continue doing?

demo_sv05.title: Upward Manager Feedback
demo_sv05.description: Give leaders a clear picture of how they are experienced by their teams.

questions.text: My manager communicates clearly.
My manager supports my development.
My manager recognises good work.
My manager is approachable when I have a problem.
What is one thing my manager should do more of?
What is one thing my manager should do less of?

demo_sv06.title: New Joiner Check-In
demo_sv06.description: A 30-day check-in to see how new colleagues are settling in.

questions.text: The onboarding process prepared me well for my role.
I feel welcomed by my team.
I have the tools and access I need.
My role matches what I was told during hiring.
How would you rate your first month?
What would have made your first weeks easier?

items.title: One-tap leave approval from the manager’s phone
items.problem: Managers approve leave late because it needs a laptop and several clicks.
items.idea: Send a notification with Approve and Decline buttons that work from a phone, with the team calendar shown underneath.
items.benefit: Faster answers for employees and fewer reminders for HR.
items.resources: Small change to notifications; no new tools.
items.note: Live now. Thank you for the idea.

items.title: Flexible start times for customer care shifts
items.problem: Fixed shift starts make commuting hard in peak traffic and cause late arrivals.
items.idea: Allow a 45-minute window for shift start, with the shift end moving to match.
items.benefit: Less stress and better punctuality.
items.resources: Rota adjustment only.
items.note: Thank you. This does not fit our current service levels but we are keeping it for the next rota review.

items.title: Quiet focus hours on Wednesday mornings
items.problem: Meetings fill every morning and deep work happens late in the evening.
items.idea: Make Wednesday morning meeting-free for everyone, so teams can plan, write and think.
items.benefit: Better focus, fewer late finishes and a healthier workload.
items.resources: A company-wide agreement and a calendar reminder.
items.note: This is now a company practice. Thank you.

items.title: لوحة شكر شهرية لفرق الدعم الخلفي
items.problem: فرق الدعم الخلفي نادرًا ما تُذكر رغم أن عملها أساسي.
items.idea: لوحة شهرية تُظهر رسائل شكر من الزملاء لفرق الدعم، مع تقدير بسيط في الاجتماع العام.
items.benefit: روح معنوية أعلى وتقدير أوسع.
items.resources: مساحة على الصفحة الداخلية.
items.note: شكرًا لك. حفظنا الفكرة لمراجعة برنامج التقدير القادم.

items.title: Self-service SIM replacement kiosks
items.problem: Customers queue for up to an hour in our stores just to replace a lost SIM card.
items.idea: Put self-service kiosks in the busiest stores. The customer scans an ID, verifies by SMS and the SIM is issued on the spot.
items.benefit: Shorter queues, happier customers and store staff free for advice and sales.
items.resources: Kiosk hardware for ten stores, an ID verification service and two weeks of integration work.

addenda.text: We could also use the kiosk for plan changes and bill payments.

items.note: Thank you. A pilot is under way in two stores and your input shaped it.

items.title: Buddy programme for new joiners in the regions
items.problem: New colleagues outside Baghdad often feel disconnected in their first months.
items.idea: Pair every new joiner with a buddy for 90 days, with a short guide, a monthly check-in and a small recognition for buddies.
items.benefit: Faster settling in, lower early resignations and stronger local culture.
items.resources: A one-page guide and a recognition budget.
items.note: Piloting in two regions. We will share the results with you.

items.title: Auto-reset for common IT passwords
items.problem: Password resets are among the most common IT tickets.
items.idea: Let employees reset their own password with a phone code, without raising a ticket.
items.benefit: Fewer tickets and less waiting.
items.resources: A self-service reset tool.
items.note: Live for everyone. Thank you.

items.title: Reuse old routers for school internet labs
items.problem: Returned routers are stored for years while many schools have no reliable internet.
items.idea: Refurbish returned routers and install them in school computer labs, with volunteers teaching basic IT.
items.benefit: Less e-waste and connected classrooms in our communities.
items.resources: A refurbishment bench, a few volunteers and transport to schools.
items.note: We have shared this with the team that owns community programmes.

items.title: Carbon label on every procurement order
items.problem: We do not see the carbon footprint of what we buy.
items.idea: Ask suppliers for a simple carbon figure and show it on each purchase request, so buyers can compare.
items.benefit: Smarter purchasing and better sustainability reporting.
items.resources: A new field in the request form and a supplier questionnaire.
items.note: A great fit for next year’s supplier programme. We have kept it on file.

items.title: Chatbot for the first answers about benefits and leave
items.problem: HR answers the same ten questions every day by phone and email.
items.idea: Add a chat assistant to the employee page that answers questions about leave, benefits and payslips, and passes harder ones to HR.
items.benefit: Instant answers at any hour and more time for HR on complex cases.
items.resources: Knowledge articles already exist; needs a chat interface.

items.title: مكتبة مصغّرة لتبادل الكتب في كل مبنى
items.problem: لا يوجد مكان بسيط لتبادل الكتب والمعرفة بين الزملاء.
items.idea: تخصيص رفّ في كل مبنى لتبادل الكتب، مع نشاط شهري قصير لعرض كتاب مفيد.
items.benefit: ثقافة قراءة وتعلّم وتواصل أفضل بين الفرق.
items.resources: رفوف وبعض الكتب المبدئية.
items.note: شاركناها مع فريق التعلّم والتطوير.

items.title: Prepaid top-up reminders based on usage
items.problem: Prepaid customers run out of balance at the worst moment and switch to a competitor.
items.idea: Send a friendly reminder before the balance runs out, with a one-tap top-up and a small bonus for early top-up.
items.benefit: Fewer lost customers and more predictable revenue.
items.resources: Usage data already exists; needs a message template and a bonus rule.
items.note: Shared with the team that owns prepaid products.

items.title: Paperless handover for field engineers
items.problem: Field teams fill paper forms after each job and someone re-types them at the office.
items.idea: Use a simple mobile form with photos and a signature, saved straight to the job record.
items.benefit: No re-typing, fewer errors and faster invoicing.
items.resources: A mobile form tool and short training.

items.title: Printed monthly newsletter for stores without reliable internet
items.problem: Some store teams miss company news.
items.idea: Send a one-page printed summary each month to every store.
items.benefit: Everyone informed.
items.resources: Printing costs.

items.title: Customer loyalty tiers for long-standing subscribers
items.problem: Customers who stay for many years get no more than new customers.
items.idea: Create bronze, silver and gold tiers by years with us, with small perks such as priority care and bonus data.
items.benefit: Loyalty, lower churn and a reason to stay.
items.resources: Tier rules and a perks budget.

items.title: تذكير تلقائي بتجديد الباقة قبل انتهائها
items.problem: ينسى كثير من العملاء تجديد باقاتهم فتنقطع الخدمة.
items.idea: إرسال رسالة قبل ثلاثة أيام من انتهاء الباقة مع رابط للتجديد بنقرة واحدة.
items.benefit: عملاء أكثر رضا وإيراد أكثر استقرارًا.
items.resources: قالب رسالة وقاعدة توقيت.

items.title: Open workshop: employees pitch ideas to leaders every quarter
items.problem: Good ideas get lost because there is no regular place to present them.
items.idea: Hold a short quarterly session where five employees present ideas to senior leaders, and the best get time and a mentor.
items.benefit: A culture of ownership and a steady stream of improvements.
items.resources: Two hours a quarter and a small budget for prototypes.

items.title: Show data usage in the app as a daily bar
items.problem: Customers only see their data usage as a total and are surprised by the end of the month.
items.idea: Show a simple daily bar chart with a forecast to the end of the plan.
items.benefit: Fewer complaints and fewer surprise top-ups.
items.resources: App design and data from billing.

items.title: Standing desks and walking meeting rooms
items.problem: Many colleagues sit for most of the day and report back pain.
items.idea: Offer sit-stand desks on request and mark two meeting rooms for walking meetings.
items.benefit: Better health and energy.
items.resources: A small furniture budget.

items.title: Smart reply suggestions for customer care agents
items.problem: Agents type similar replies all day, which is slow and uneven in tone.
items.idea: Suggest short replies based on the customer’s question, which the agent can edit and send.
items.benefit: Faster handling and a consistent voice.
items.resources: An assistant tool and agent feedback during testing.

items.title: Joint training day with local universities
items.problem: Graduates often do not know what skills telecom needs.
items.idea: Invite final-year students for a practical day with our engineers, with case studies and a short talk on careers.
items.benefit: A stronger talent pipeline and a better reputation.
items.resources: A venue, a day of engineers’ time and lunch.

items.title: Recycle SIM cards and packaging at stores
items.problem: Packaging and old SIM cards end up in the bin.
items.idea: Place collection boxes in stores and send the contents to a recycler, with a small reward for customers who return them.
items.benefit: Less waste and a visible sustainability message.
items.resources: Boxes and a recycler contract.

demo_er_late1.description: Eleven late arrivals recorded over a three-week period, none with prior notice to the line manager.

timeline.text: Case opened — disciplinary case, low severity.
Status changed from Reported to Investigating.
Attendance records reviewed: 11 arrivals more than 15 minutes after the start of the shift.
The employee said the delays came from a change in transport and agreed to leave earlier.
Verbal warning.
Status changed from Decision pending to Closed.

outcome.notes: Verbal warning recorded. The employee agreed to adjust their commute and to tell their manager about any delay before the shift starts.

demo_er_grv1.description: The employee reports that team objectives are changed without discussion and that feedback is given in front of colleagues.

timeline.text: Case opened — grievance, medium severity.
Status changed from Reported to Investigating.
Interviewed the employee, who gave two recent examples.
Joint conversation held with the line manager. Both agreed to a weekly one-to-one and private feedback.
Informal resolution / coaching.
Status changed from Decision pending to Closed.

outcome.notes: Resolved informally. The line manager will attend a coaching session on giving feedback and HR will check in after eight weeks.

demo_er_upheld.description: The employee reports being left out of planning meetings that affect their work.

timeline.text: Case opened — grievance, medium severity.
Status changed from Reported to Investigating.
Interviewed the employee and the meeting organiser.
Meeting invitations for the last quarter show the employee was not invited to six planning sessions.
Grievance upheld — remedy agreed.
Status changed from Decision pending to Closed.

outcome.notes: Grievance upheld. The employee joins the weekly planning meeting and has a quarterly check-in with the director.

demo_er_leak.description: A draft pricing document marked internal was sent to an external contact outside an approved channel.

timeline.text: Case opened — disciplinary case, medium severity.
Status changed from Reported to Investigating.
The email log shows the document attached to a message sent to a personal address.
The employee confirmed sending the file to speed up a customer request.
The policy was reviewed with the employee, who acknowledged the breach.
First written warning.
Status changed from Decision pending to Closed.

outcome.notes: First written warning for sharing internal information outside approved channels. The employee will repeat the Information Security course within 30 days.

demo_er_nofind.description: A supplier raised a concern about how a bid was evaluated. HR reviewed the evaluation records.

timeline.text: Case opened — investigation, medium severity.
Status changed from Reported to Investigating.
Evaluation sheets and scoring notes were reviewed.
Evaluation panel members were interviewed separately.
No action — not substantiated.
Status changed from Decision pending to Closed.

outcome.notes: The review found the evaluation followed the published procedure. No further action.

demo_er_prior.description: Safety checklist sign-offs were missed on several shifts over two months.

timeline.text: Case opened — disciplinary case, medium severity.
Status changed from Reported to Investigating.
Checklist records show eight shifts without sign-off.
The employee accepted the findings and said the checklist was being completed after the shift ended.
Second written warning.
Status changed from Decision pending to Closed.

outcome.notes: Second written warning for repeated missed safety checklist sign-offs, following an earlier first written warning.

demo_er_late2.description: Late arrivals again after the earlier verbal warning had lapsed: nine occurrences in one month.

timeline.text: Case opened — disciplinary case, medium severity.
Status changed from Reported to Investigating.
Attendance records show nine late arrivals in the month.
A shift adjustment was offered and declined.
First written warning.
Status changed from Decision pending to Closed.

outcome.notes: First written warning. The earlier verbal warning is noted on file and the employee was reminded of the attendance policy.

demo_er_appeal.description: A colleague reported repeated inappropriate behaviour towards them during shift handovers.

timeline.text: Case opened — disciplinary case, medium severity.
Status changed from Reported to Investigating.
Two colleagues gave consistent statements about the handovers.
Hearing held. The employee attended with a colleague and responded to each point.
Final written warning.
The employee lodged a written appeal. HR is reviewing the grounds of appeal before a second reviewer is appointed.
Status changed from Decision pending to Appealed.

outcome.notes: Final written warning for inappropriate behaviour towards a colleague. The earlier second written warning is still active.

demo_er_exp.description: Three expense claims contain receipts with the same reference number. Finance asked HR to review whether the duplication is accidental.

timeline.text: Case opened — investigation, high severity.
Status changed from Reported to Investigating.
Finance provided the three claims and the matching receipts.
The first interview with the claimant was held and follow-up questions were sent in writing.

demo_er_hearing.description: The employee left a customer site without notice during an assignment and could not be reached for several hours.

timeline.text: Case opened — disciplinary case, medium severity.
Status changed from Reported to Investigating.
The line manager’s account was recorded.
The employee was given the allegation in writing and invited to respond.
Hearing invitation sent. The employee may bring a colleague, and the hearing is set for later this week.

demo_er_remarks.description: A concern describes repeated unprofessional remarks about colleagues during team meetings, and asks for a formal review.

timeline.text: Case opened — grievance, high severity.
Status changed from Reported to Investigating.
Scope agreed with the HR lead. Two witnesses identified.
The first witness confirmed remarks were made on at least two occasions.

demo_er_perf.description: Monthly quality targets were missed for three consecutive months despite a coaching plan.

timeline.text: Case opened — disciplinary case, low severity.
Status changed from Reported to Investigating.
Quality scores and coaching notes for the period were reviewed.
Performance meeting held. The employee has asked for more training.
Hearing held. The employee attended and responded to each point.
Status changed from Hearing scheduled to Decision pending.

demo_er_safety.description: A near-miss was reported at a field site where a safety harness check was skipped. No injury. The sign-off process and the people involved are being reviewed.

timeline.text: Case opened — investigation, critical severity.
Status changed from Reported to Investigating.
Site checklist and photos collected.
The site supervisor was interviewed.

demo_er_shift.description: The employee feels weekend shifts are shared unevenly across the team and asks for the roster to be reviewed.

timeline.text: Case opened — grievance, low severity.
Acknowledgement sent. Roster data requested from the line manager.

demo_er_withdrawn.description: Unexplained absences on four days within one month.

timeline.text: Case opened — disciplinary case, low severity.
Status changed from Reported to Investigating.
Attempts to reach the employee by phone and email were recorded.
The employee resigned during the process. The case was withdrawn with no finding.
Status changed from Investigating to Withdrawn.

demo_er_staffM.description: Three late arrivals within a month, each without notice to the line manager.

timeline.text: Case opened — disciplinary case, low severity.
Status changed from Reported to Investigating.
Attendance records reviewed for the month.
The employee explained a temporary family commitment and agreed a plan.
Verbal warning.
Status changed from Decision pending to Closed.

outcome.notes: Verbal warning for three late arrivals this month. The employee will tell the line manager about any delay before the shift starts.

demo_ig01.title: Raise women in management to 30% by the end of next year

actions.text: Set a shortlist rule: at least one woman on every management shortlist
Launch a sponsorship pairing for women team leads
Review promotion decisions for fairness each half-year
Add two women to the Top Talent (T3) pool for each cycle
Run an executive sponsorship programme

demo_ig03.title: Bring the like-for-like gender pay gap under 3%

actions.text: Analyse pay by grade and role and list unexplained gaps
Include a pay-equity adjustment in the next compensation cycle
Publish the method and result to leadership

demo_ig04.title: Get everyone through the required IDE learning

actions.text: Send monthly reminders to people with overdue IDE courses
Make Inclusive Leadership part of every manager’s first-year plan
Add a short IDE module to onboarding

demo_ig05.title: Lift inclusion favourable to 80% in the annual pulse

actions.text: Share pulse results and a "you said, we did" summary
Start a listening session in every division

demo_ig06.title: Decide every adjustment request within 14 days

actions.text: Agree a named HR case owner for every request
Add a reminder for requests waiting more than 10 days

Hold the first open meeting
Agree the network charter with the executive sponsor

actions.text: Draft the policy with Legal
Approve the policy at the executive committee
Announce to all employees

demo_ci01.title: Solar Power for Remote Sites
demo_ci01.description: Add solar panels and batteries to the five most remote tower sites to cut diesel use and emissions.

updates.text: Kick-off held with the working group.
Panels live at three of five sites; fuel use at those sites is down.

demo_ci02.title: E-Waste Take-Back and Recycling
demo_ci02.description: Collect old phones, routers and batteries from customers and send them to certified recyclers.

updates.text: Kick-off held with the working group.
Bins now in nine stores; first full truckload recycled.

demo_ci03.title: Generator Fuel Reduction Plan
demo_ci03.description: Cut generator hours with better scheduling, maintenance and hybrid power.

updates.text: Kick-off held with the working group.
Two sites delayed by spare-part shipments.

demo_ci04.title: Green Office Programme
demo_ci04.description: Cut paper, water and electricity in our offices and move to paperless HR processes.

updates.text: Kick-off held with the working group.
Paperless leave, expenses and contracts are live across HR.

demo_ci05.title: Safety First: ISO 45001 Readiness
demo_ci05.description: Prepare field and office teams for an occupational health and safety management system.

updates.text: Kick-off held with the working group.
Risk assessments finished at 60% of sites.

demo_ci06.title: Digital Skills for Schools
demo_ci06.description: Volunteer-led digital literacy classes and device donations for schools in our cities.

updates.text: Kick-off held with the working group.
Over 3,000 students reached so far.

demo_ci07.title: Code of Conduct Refresh
demo_ci07.description: Update the code of conduct and have every employee read and acknowledge it each year.

updates.text: Kick-off held with the working group.
New code approved; acknowledgements at 80%.

demo_ci08.title: Supplier Code of Conduct Roll-Out
demo_ci08.description: Ask every supplier to sign our code covering labour, ethics and environment.

updates.text: Kick-off held with the working group.
Large suppliers have signed; small ones are slower.

demo_ci09.title: Intrapreneurs Challenge
demo_ci09.description: A yearly challenge where employee teams pitch ideas and the best get funding, time and a mentor.

updates.text: Kick-off held with the working group.
Twelve teams shortlisted; four pilots funded.

demo_ci10.title: Local Supplier Growth Programme
demo_ci10.description: Training, fair payment terms and introductions for small local suppliers.

updates.text: Kick-off held with the working group.
38 suppliers enrolled; payment time cut from 90 to 45 days.

demo_ci11.title: Young Entrepreneurs Digital Bootcamp
demo_ci11.description: A free eight-week bootcamp on business basics, digital marketing and mobile payments.

updates.text: Kick-off held with the working group.
Second cohort starts next month.

demo_ci12.title: Start-Up Mentoring Circle
demo_ci12.description: Managers volunteer as mentors to start-ups from a local incubator.

updates.text: Kick-off held with the working group.
Fifteen start-ups matched with mentors.

demo_ci13.title: Women Micro-Enterprise Training
demo_ci13.description: Six-week business skills and micro-loan introductions for women entrepreneurs outside Baghdad.

updates.text: Kick-off held with the working group.
Partner organisation confirmed; curriculum being prepared.

items.details: The side door to the equipment room is often propped open during shifts, and the extinguisher tag there shows it is past its inspection date.

Overtime has been worked for several weeks without written approval, and then challenged afterwards when claims are submitted.
Requests to swap shifts are refused without an explanation, and the same people seem to be refused each time.
A colleague regularly makes unprofessional remarks about others in team meetings. I would like HR to look into it formally.
A harness check was skipped at a field site last week. Nobody was hurt, but this should be looked at.
I would like to move desks because of the noise from the kitchen area.
I want to add detail to a matter that is already being handled by my manager.

items.title: Turn retired routers into Wi-Fi kits for rural schools
items.problem: Schools outside the cities have no reliable internet, and we scrap working routers every quarter.
items.idea: Refurbish returned routers and ship them to partner schools with a simple set-up guide.
items.benefit: Students get connectivity and we cut e-waste.
items.response: Approved for a three-school pilot. Thank you — Network Operations will join you.

items.title: Solar panels for remote tower sites
items.problem: Diesel generators at remote sites are our largest fuel cost and a big source of emissions.
items.idea: Pair batteries and solar panels with the generators at the five most remote sites.
items.benefit: Lower fuel cost and emissions; fewer fuel deliveries.
items.response: Now rolling out to more sites as part of the Solar Power for Remote Sites initiative.

items.title: Small-business starter pack for local shops
items.problem: Small shops near our stores do not know how to take mobile payments or sell online.
items.idea: A free starter pack: a short course, a mobile-money account set-up and a listing on our app.
items.benefit: Shops grow; we gain loyal customers.
items.response: We are working with the commercial team on a design. Please keep in touch.

items.title: Paperless contracts for all enterprise customers
items.problem: Each enterprise contract uses dozens of printed pages and courier trips.
items.idea: Move contract signing to a secure e-signature flow.
items.benefit: Faster signing, less paper and fuel.
items.response: Thank you — we are looking at this now.

items.title: Mentoring corner for young entrepreneurs
items.problem: Many graduates in our cities have business ideas but no one to ask.
items.idea: A monthly open evening where volunteer managers mentor young founders.
items.benefit: Better-prepared young businesses.
items.response: Pilot starts next month in Baghdad. Welcome aboard.

items.title: Innovation hour every Thursday
items.problem: Teams are too busy to try small improvements.
items.idea: Protect one hour a week for teams to test an improvement.
items.benefit: More small wins, higher morale.
items.response: Great spirit, but it clashes with the peak support schedule. We will revisit after the busy season.

items.title: Recycle old SIM cards and packaging
items.problem: Plastic SIM cards and packaging go to waste.
items.idea: Add collection bins at stores and send the plastic to a recycler.
items.benefit: Less waste; a visible green step for customers.
items.response: Included in the e-waste take-back plan.

items.title: Supplier payment in 30 days for small vendors
items.problem: Small suppliers wait 90 days to be paid, which hurts their cash flow.
items.idea: A fast-pay lane for suppliers under a set size.
items.benefit: Healthier small suppliers and a more reliable supply chain.
items.response: Thank you — we are looking at this now.

items.title: Voice-based service for people who cannot read
items.problem: Some customers struggle with text menus.
items.idea: Add a voice menu in local dialects for the top ten services.
items.benefit: More people can use our services independently.
items.response: Already on the product roadmap for next year, so we will not run a separate pilot. Thank you.

items.title: Women-led micro-enterprise training in Erbil
items.problem: Women entrepreneurs have fewer networks and less access to training.
items.idea: Partner with a local group to run a six-week business skills course.
items.benefit: More women-owned businesses.
items.response: We have a partner interested. A concept note is being prepared.

items.title: Carpool board for the Baghdad head office
items.problem: Many colleagues drive alone along the same routes.
items.idea: A simple board in SNAP to match carpool partners.
items.benefit: Fewer cars, lower fuel use, less traffic.

items.title: Idea marketplace between divisions
items.problem: Teams solve the same problems separately.
items.idea: A monthly show-and-tell where teams share what worked.
items.benefit: Less duplication.

items.title: Local artisan gift shop in our stores
items.problem: Local craftspeople struggle to reach customers.
items.idea: Display and sell local crafts in selected flagship stores.
items.benefit: Income for artisans and a unique offer for us.
items.response: Pilot running in two stores.

items.title: Free coding club for employees’ children
items.problem: Children have few places to learn coding.
items.idea: Saturday club run by volunteers from IT.
items.benefit: Digital skills for the next generation.
